meta.task: Step 1 (other-AI report proposal 3): BM25F field-weighted scoring vs concatenated stack

fields.body: article full text (engine full, caption included)
fields.meta: chapter/section + fingerprint words + canonical numeric tokens (countermeasures meta_string, identical construction)

variants.tfidf: measure50 score_docs formula applied per field; per-field length normalization (body uses engine avg_tot, others use pool-field means); body includes caption boost (cap_grams x2.2, term-in-cap +1.1)
variants.bm25: textbook BM25 per field; per-field IDF over the 463 pool articles log(1+(N-df+0.5)/(df+0.5)); tokens = char 2/3-grams + TERMS (occurrence tf); query grams distinct; params body k1=1.2 b=0.75, meta k1=1.2 b=0.3, tag k1=0.2 b=0.75, exception k1=1.2 b=0.75
variants.bm25_bmeta0: same as bm25 but meta b=0.0 (proposal range 0.0-0.3 lower end)

meta.weights: body fixed 1.0; grid meta{0.4,0.5,0.6} x tag{0.2,0.25,0.3} x exc{0.2,0.3,0.4} = 27 patterns, all reported; diagnostics body_only and center_noexc
meta.verification: baseline and concatenated stack (meta_append) reproduced for all in-pool questions before measuring
